card.title: The Approved Explanation
card.instruction: Protect someone or the group by maintaining a simplified account that everyone can safely repeat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Grandad's embarrassed about the gazebo. Let's tell everyone the party moved indoors because the garden's unavailable.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's already told Aunt Jean he set it on fire.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we all say, 'Everyone's fine; we're celebrating indoors.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Jean wants him to explain it in his birthday speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's his opening sentence too. Then straight to thanking her for the trifle.

mechanism: A shields an embarrassed grandfather by preserving a simple safe-party message even when his own disclosure invites a public explanation.
confusable: Unlike purely private comfort, A wants a repeatable account usable by the group and the person being protected.
comparison: A birthday speech gets the same safe sentence, unlike the bus scene's factual qualifier across parents and office.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
